Context: 4. Commutation of Pension

| 61 | 8.194 | 22,800 | X 8.194 | X 12 = | ~ 22,41,879 |  
The 'age next birthday' for the purpose of finding out commutation value should be reckoned with reference to the date on which the commutation becomes absolute. Commutation amount should be expressed in whole rupees and where the final calculation of commutation amount contains a fraction of a rupee, it shall be rounded off to the next higher rupee.
